reasoning: The specification names several internal FSM states, timing events, filtered-line conditions, and control flags that are not ports. Each is represented by a one-bit situation probe. The command-completion, bus-busy, arbitration-lost, received-data, and output-enable signals are already declared ports, so no aliases are needed.
